issues.display_title: Issue #400: Refactor Post Block and Check APIs to Use GORM Models
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 22/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Post Block and Check APIs

This document tracks the execution details for the post block/check GORM refactoring.

Phase 1: Block Post

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/BlockPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added imports for Models, uuid, and gorm.
    • Replaced map-based post lookup with Models.Post.
    • Replaced direct blocked-post lookup with Models.BlockedPosts.
    • Replaced raw blocked-post insert with Config.DB.Create(&Models.BlockedPosts{...}) and explicit UUID generation.
    • Replaced raw blocked-post delete with Config.DB.Delete(&Models.BlockedPosts{}, ...).
    • Replaced raw bookmark delete with Config.DB.Delete(&Models.Bookmark{}, ...).
    • Kept Table("bookmark b") on the bookmark cleanup query because the joined query still uses the b alias.
    • Preserved private-post validation, own-post validation, bookmark cleanup, ElasticSearch counter updates, Redis blocked-post refresh, and response messages.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Phase 2: Check Post

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/CheckPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added imports for Models, uuid, and gorm.
    • Replaced direct posts table lookup with Models.Post.
    • Preserved SID validation, unpublished-post check, not-found behavior, and response messages.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Verification

  • Ran go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts.
  • Result: passed with no test files.
  • Ran raw SQL scan on BlockPost.go and CheckPost.go.
  • Result: no Config.DB.Raw, Config.DB.Exec, .Raw(, or .Exec( calls remain in the two files. One Table("bookmark b") call remains intentionally to provide the b alias for the joined bookmark cleanup query.

Background

The small post moderation endpoints still use direct table access and raw SQL for post lookup, blocked-post toggle, bookmark cleanup, and draft post checks. These can use existing GORM models (Models.Post, Models.BlockedPosts, Models.Bookmark) while preserving Redis, ElasticSearch, and response behavior.

Objective

Refactor post block/unblock and check endpoints to use GORM models for lookups, creates, updates, and deletes.

APIs to Refactor

  • BlockPost.go: Replace direct posts, blocked_posts, and bookmark table access plus raw insert/delete with GORM models.
  • CheckPost.go: Replace direct posts table lookup with Models.Post.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No raw SQL INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE queries remain in the refactored endpoints.
  • Block/unblock behavior remains unchanged.
  • Blocking a private post remains forbidden.
  • Blocking the user's own post remains forbidden.
  • Bookmark cleanup and ElasticSearch counter updates remain unchanged.
  • Redis blocked-post cache refresh remains unchanged.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts

Background

Post score and view endpoints still use direct table access and raw SQL for post lookup, score queue insertion, view lookup, and view insertion. These can use existing GORM models while preserving Redis filtering, response behavior, and ElasticSearch counter updates.

issues.display_title: Issue #402: Refactor Post Draft and Panorama Cleanup APIs to Use GORM Models
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 22/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Post Draft and Panorama Cleanup APIs

This document tracks the execution details for the draft/panorama cleanup GORM refactoring.

Phase 1: Add Draft Post Panorama

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddDraftPostPanorama.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced raw UPDATE posts statement with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).Update(...).
    • Preserved SID/default-thumbnail validation, joined panorama thumbnail lookup, and response messages.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Phase 2: Delete Draft Post

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DeleteDraftPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced raw DELETE FROM multiple_post with Config.DB.Delete(&Models.MultiplePost{}, ...).
    • Replaced raw DELETE FROM posts with Config.DB.Delete(&Models.Post{}, ...).
    • Preserved type validation, unpublished draft lookup, local file cleanup, MinIO cleanup, Redis panorama status cleanup, and response messages.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Phase 3: Delete Panorama Post

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DeletePanoramaPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced raw DELETE FROM multiple_post with Config.DB.Delete(&Models.MultiplePost{}, ...).
    • Preserved request validation, panorama lookup, local file cleanup, MinIO cleanup, Redis panorama status cleanup, and response messages.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Verification

  • Ran go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts.
  • Result: passed with no test files.
  • Ran raw SQL scan on AddDraftPostPanorama.go, DeleteDraftPost.go, and DeletePanoramaPost.go.

Background

Draft and panorama cleanup endpoints still use direct table access plus raw SQL updates/deletes for draft thumbnail selection, draft deletion, and panorama item deletion. These can use existing GORM models while preserving file cleanup, MinIO cleanup, Redis panorama status cleanup, and response behavior.

Objective

Refactor draft/panorama cleanup endpoints to use GORM models for post updates and deletes.

APIs to Refactor

  • AddDraftPostPanorama.go: Replace raw posts update with Models.Post.
  • DeleteDraftPost.go: Replace raw multiple_post and posts deletes with Models.MultiplePost and Models.Post.
  • DeletePanoramaPost.go: Replace raw multiple_post delete with Models.MultiplePost.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No raw SQL UPDATE or DELETE queries remain in the refactored endpoints.
  • Existing validation and response messages remain unchanged.
  • Draft thumbnail selection remains unchanged.
  • Draft panorama file cleanup remains unchanged.
  • MinIO cleanup remains unchanged.
  • Redis panorama status cleanup remains unchanged.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts
